newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE COFFEE ENDS MIXED, ACTIVE MONTHS UP, QUIET.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE COFFEE ENDS MIXED, ACTIVE MONTHS UP, QUIET.

text.p: LIFFE coffee ended mixed in thin volume, with the front two months, which dominated trading, last traded just off lows.
Front month September was most active, with 1,119 of the total 2,179 lots. It last traded $15 higher at $1,630, compared with a high of $1,635 and a low of $1,595.
One trader called it "another weak performance," in a rangebound market. Support at $1,595 on September had held, he noted.
But it would take a break of resistances above $1,675 to make the picture look more bullish, he said.
